name: Emissary of Soulfire
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E}{E} (three energy counters).
Pay {E}{E}: Put an exalted counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery. (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.)
blocked_sentences: Pay {E}{E}: Put an exalted counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an exalted keyword counter (122.1b): add_counters with counter "exalted" on a permanent must grant that permanent the exalted keyword for as long as the counter remains, and each such counter counts as an instance of exalted
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exalted exists as a keyword and grant_keyword can give it until end of turn or permanently, but that is not a counter: it is not removable/movable/proliferatable as a counter and does not stack as one instance per counter; nothing in reference says a named counter grants its keyword
